description: IRCTC railway booking service — search trains, check seat availability, calculate fares, and create or cancel bookings. READ THE '00-start-here' SKILL FIRST. Call GET /health before picking any journey_date — never guess a year/date from memory. Never write custom filtering/sorting code or invent parameters — use only what the OpenAPI spec documents. Some trains run with limited or sold-out capacity (0 seats is a valid result, not a bug). This service does not enforce booking policy (Tatkal group size, max fare) — that is Harbor's job, not yours.
